title: Ensure 'Configure the transmission of the user's password in the content of MPR notifications sent by winlogon.' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Logon Options\Configure the transmission of the user's password in the content of MPR notifications sent by winlogon to 'Disabled'
reason: The user's password field of MPR notifications should be empty to prevent abuse by threat actors.

title: Ensure 'Sign-in and lock last interactive user automatically after a restart' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Logon Options\Sign-in and lock last interactive user automatically after a restart to 'Disabled'
reason: Disabling this feature will prevent the caching of user's credentials and unauthorized use of the device.

title: Ensure 'Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging to 'Enabled'
reason: This policy setting enables logging of all PowerShell script input to the Applications and Services Logs for forensic investigations.

title: Ensure 'Turn on PowerShell Transcription' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows PowerShell\Turn on PowerShell Transcription to 'Enabled'
reason: PowerShell transcript input can be very valuable when performing forensic investigations of PowerShell attack incidents to determine what occurred.
